To All Filipino Compatriots in and out of the country! Attention Please!
From the UNITED PEOPLE’S INITIATIVE (UPI)

RALLY FOR ACCOUNTABILITY, JUSTICE, AND INTEGRITY

🕊️ November 16–18, 2025 • EDSA People Power Monument, EDSA, Quezon City

A Peaceful Call of the Nation

Fellow Filipinos,
Our nation continues to be poisoned by corruption and dishonesty. It is time to take a stand for Accountability, Justice, and Integrity in public service. This is a peaceful protest—a movement of conscience and the moral dignity of the Filipino people.

Let us Stand Together!
🕊️ With members of INC, JIL, KOJC, Catholics, Muslims, and other religious organizations
 🎓 With youth, students, workers, and professionals
 🎖️ With retired soldiers, police, and uniformed personnel
 👥 With civil society groups and all citizens who care deeply for our nation

📅 November 16–18, 2025
 📍 EDSA People Power Monument
 🕊️ Peaceful. Dignified. United. In solidarity with the INC Rally at Luneta.

UNITED PEOPLE’S INITIATIVE (UPI)
 For God. For the Nation. For the Filipino People.
“See you there, my fellow countrymen!!!”
----
In Filipino!
🇵🇭UNITED PEOPLE’S INITIATIVE (UPI)
RALLY PARA SA PANANAGUTAN, KATARUNGAN AT KATAPATAN
🕊️Nobyembre 16–18, 2025 • EDSA People Power Monument, EDSA, Quezon City
Isang Mapayapang Panawagan ng Bayan
Mga Kababayan,
Ang ating bansa ay patuloy na nilalason ng korapsyon at kawalang-katapatan.
Panahon na upang manindigan — para sa Pananagutan, Katarungan, at Katapatan sa paglilingkod-bayan.
Ito ay isang mapayapang protesta - pagkilos ng budhi at dangal ng sambayanang Pilipino.
Sama-sama tayong tumindig!
🕊️Kasama ang INC, JIL, KOJC, mga miyembro ng Katoliko, Muslim, at iba pang relihiyosong organisasyon
🎓Kasama ang kabataan, estudyante, manggagawa, at propesyonal

🎖️Kasama ang retiradong sundalo, pulis, at unipormadong kawani
👥Kasama ang iba’t ibang civil society groups at lahat ng mamamayang may malasakit sa bayan
📅Nobyembre 16–18, 2025
📍EDSA People Power Monument
🕊️Mapayapa. Marangal. Nagkakaisa. Kasabay at Kasama ang INC Rally sa Luneta.

UNITED PEOPLE’S INITIATIVE (UPI)

Para sa Diyos. Para sa Bayan. Para sa Sambayanang Pilipino.
Kitakits mga Kabansa!
